model: MCH Series drive (AC Tech, BACnet MS/TP)
applies_to: Lenze AC Tech MCH Series HVAC variable frequency drives with the native BACnet MS/TP option.
summary: The MCH Series is an older Lenze AC Tech HVAC drive. The BACnet version talks BACnet MS/TP as a slave device at 9600 baud, so the BMS must bind to it statically. It has a small fixed object set: speed and PID setpoint commands, run/stop, fault reset, and status and fault readbacks.
notes: The drive is an MS/TP slave, so only BMS devices that support static device binding can reach it.
Default MAC address is 128 (parameter 58, range 0-254); baud rate is fixed at 9600.
Device instance is set with parameters 85 (bits 16-22) and 86 (bits 0-15); default 1240000.
Object names are the short names printed in brackets in the object map; the access column is inferred from object type and the object descriptions.

source.title: MCH Series Drives BACnet Communications Guide

points.name: FAULT
points.states: 1=NO FAULT, 2=OUTPUT, 3=E-STOP, 4=HI VOLTS, 5=HI TEMP, 6=OVERLOAD, 7=OUTPUT, 8=LO VOLTS, 9=START ER, 10=BRAKE ER, 11=FOLLOWER, 12=DB ERROR, 13=PWR SAG, 14=CONTROL, 15=LANGUAGE, 16=EXTERNAL, 17=INTERNAL16, 18=PWR TRAN, 19=INTERNAL18, 20=INTERNAL19, 21=INTERNAL20, 22=INTERNAL21, 23=INTERNAL22, 24=INTERNAL23, 25=SERIAL

integration.summary: Leave parameter 57 Serial at WITH TIMER, give the drive a MAC address and device number, keep parameter 24 Auto Source at KEYPAD and set parameter 30 Control to SERIAL AUTO (or S AUTO/NO HND). With the H/O/A in AUTO the BMS can then start the drive with BO 1 and set speed with AV 1 (or the PID setpoint with AV 2).

minimum_points.name: CLEAR FAULT
minimum_points.why: Fault reset; write CLR then NRM

minimum_points.name: HOA MODE
minimum_points.why: Must be AUTO for LAN commands

integration.enable: Parameter 57 Serial must be WITH TIMER or W/O TIMER and parameter 24 Auto Source must be KEYPAD. Parameter 30 Control sets what the LAN may do: SERIAL SPEED allows speed/setpoint only, SERIAL AUTO or S AUTO/NO HND also allows start. The H/O/A must be in AUTO; in OFF or HAND the drive ignores LAN start and speed commands. LAN stop commands are always accepted.
integration.heartbeat: With parameter 57 = WITH TIMER, a serial watchdog (parameter 60, 10-65535 s, default 30 s) takes the drive out of serial control if the LAN stops talking; in SERIAL AUTO a running drive trips on SERIAL FAULT. Set parameter 57 to W/O TIMER to disable it.
gotchas: MS/TP slave only: the BMS must use static binding.
BV 1 must go back to NRM before another fault clear is accepted.
Once the LAN writes AV 1 the keypad cannot change speed until H/O/A is toggled to HAND or OFF.
LAN speed control needs MI 5 in state 1, 9 or 10; LAN setpoint control needs state 11 or 19.
The drive does not accept start commands from the LAN while in programming mode, and the display must show SSTOP for a LAN start to work.
